title: Connected dominating matching conjecture for graphs with independence number two
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph. A **connected dominating matching** is a connected matching $M$ such that every vertex outside its endpoints is adjacent to every edge of $M$. **Connected dominating matching conjecture.** Every connected graph $G$ with $\alpha(G)=2$ has a non-empty connected dominating matching. The authors state this as a strengthening of Seymour's matching conjectures and say that, to their knowledge, it remains open.
source_name: Jofre Costa, Eric Luu, David R. Wood and Jung Hon Yip, “Verifying Hadwiger's Conjecture for Examples of Graphs with α(G) = 2”, arXiv:2512.17114 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17114
